name: @heroesofcrypto/core
description: Core game logic for Heroes of Crypto

scripts.build: cross-env NODE_ENV=production bun run build:images && rimraf dist && tsc && bun scripts/vite_build.js production
scripts.build:images: bun scripts/require_asset_location.ts images && bun scripts/require_asset_location.ts animations && bun run check:animation-release && bun run check:image-assets && rimraf images && bun run copy:images && npm run generate:animations -- --copy-only && npm run generate:images
scripts.build:skip: rimraf dist && tsc && bun scripts/vite_build.js production
scripts.build:test: bun run build:images && rimraf dist && tsc && bun scripts/vite_build.js test
scripts.start: bun run generate:images && cross-env NODE_ENV=development bun --max-http-header-size=262144 ./node_modules/vite/bin/vite.js
